items.title: Returning from the AI brain-rot state, re-take the thinking ownership
items.summary:
I have suffered many stages of mental illness with the AI. There are 6 stages: Surprised: the first time I see the AI become valid in the real world. It is the Claude 3 family moment.
Exploding: I am with a god-tool in my hand.
Oversimulated: Use the god-tool to solve all the problems without thinking.
Frozen: Realize that the god-tool can solve only a few issues, and my brain is dying.
Wake-up: Understand that my brain is the main place where the problem-solving happens, not the god-tool.
Cultivating: Jump into every detail in my work. It’s not at the word-by-word level; it’s at the meaning-by-meaning level, where I can say: I have done it by myself. In other words, I re-take the thinking ownership. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49548507 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
